Program_Monitor.label: Program Monitor
Program_Monitor.description: The uCIFI Program Monitor exports some useful information related to program execution.

Status.label: Status
Status.description: Identifies the current status of the control program, taking the values: 0 - Disabled 1 - Inactive 2 - Running where 'Disabled' should be present whenever the CP has been administratively disabled. The state should be set to 'Inactive' if the calendar associated with the CP makes is NOT applicable for the current day. If the CP is administratively enabled, and either the associated calendar makes it valid for the current day or no Calendar is associated with it.

Error_Conditions.label: Error Conditions
Error_Conditions.description:
Bitmap
Bit 0: Sensor syntax error
Bit 1: Time syntax error
Bit 2: Invalid program function 
Bit 3..31: reserved for future use

Evaluation_Counter.label: Evaluation Counter
Evaluation_Counter.description: Cumulative counter for the number of times the current control program has been evaluated

Execution_Counter.label: Execution Counter
Execution_Counter.description: Cumulative counter for the number of times the current control program has ben executed after evaluation, triggering the corresponding action and output. With 'Execution counter' less than or equal to 'Evaluation counter'

Last_Execution.label: Last Execution
Last_Execution.description: Timestamp for the latest execution of the current CP

Last_Control_Output.label: Last Control Output
Last_Control_Output.description: String identifying the control output enforced during last program execution. If the control program supports multiple ouputs, one instance of this resource should be created for each output.

Clear_errors.label: Clear errors
Clear_errors.description:
When executed, clears temporary error conditions.
To be noted that some of the errors may require to change the content of the corresponding program function object to be completely cleared.

Counter_Reset.label: Counter Reset
Counter_Reset.description: Reset all counters under the current object
